definitions.explanation: A Western-style bed or sleeping platform, as opposed to a futon.
A bed on a train or ship.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {寝台|しんだい}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：noentry⟧ (sleeping car)
- {寝台|しんだい}⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧ (sleeper train)
- {寝台|しんだい}⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ (sleeper express)
- ⟦{二段|にだん}→二段：noentry⟧{寝台|しんだい} (bunk bed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧ - bed (most common everyday term)
- {寝台|しんだい} - bed (formal, or specifically for transport)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧ - futon (Japanese-style bedding)

{寝台|しんだい} is formal and commonly used for:
- Hospital beds
- Train/ship sleeping berths
- Formal contexts
